category_title: Socially isolated student with ADHD who struggles with behavioral regulation and seeks adult validation
minimal_context: Jacob is supposed to be continuing with his own tasks during independent work time while sitting near another child.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for independent work. Please stay in your seat and continue with your own tasks.

STUDENT: (Turns around a lot in order to observe what his classmates are doing)

TUTOR: Please look at your own paper.

STUDENT: It is difficult to concentrate because I feel I must comprehend everything.

TUTOR: Keep trying to do your assignment. (A child sitting near Jacob signals for help from the teacher)

STUDENT: (Immediately gets up and goes over to help the nearby child)

options.A: Have a tape recorder sound a bell every minute, prompting Jacob to record whether he remained in his seat, providing feedback afterward.
options.B: Teach Jacob to use appointment cards with a checklist of choices to access peer attention during designated times.
options.C: Proactively contact Jacob's parents (using a translator if needed) to share successes and concerns regarding his independent work.
options.D: Structure the class using cooperative learning as an alternative strategy for Jacob during independent work time.
